description: This file defines the BuzzCommentModel class which serves as a data model for representing comments in a Buzz feature within a Human Resource Management system. It includes serialization logic and mappings for various comment-related properties, linking to the BuzzComment entity.

classes.name: BuzzCommentModel
classes.description: A model class representing the API data structure for a Buzz comment, implementing serialization and normalization logic for BuzzComment entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the model with a BuzzComment entity, setting up attribute filters and names for serialization.
